in_sanskrit.name: हरिन्या
in_sanskrit.meaning: Goddess of Prosperity, Goddess of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: हरि (hari) meaning God, न्या (nya) meaning she or hers. So Harinya means 'Goddess of Her' or 'Goddess of Hers'. In Hindu mythology, Harinya is considered the goddess of prosperity and wealth.

in_hindi.name: हरिन्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: धन (dhan) meaning wealth, पत्नी (patni) meaning wife. So Harinya in Hindi translates to 'Goddess of Wealth and Wife'.

in_tamil.name: ஹரிந்யா
in_tamil.long_meaning: வெள்ளி (vel) meaning wealth, யா (ya) meaning she or hers. So Harinya in Tamil translates to 'Goddess of Her Wealth'.

in_telugu.name: హరిన్య
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేశ (desam) meaning wealth, యే (ye) meaning she or hers. So Harinya in Telugu translates to 'Goddess of Her Wealth'.

in_marathi.name: Harinya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of War, Destroyer of Enemies
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harinya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harinya is the name of the goddess of war and the destroyer of enemies. She is a fierce and powerful deity, often depicted riding a chariot and wielding weapons. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'hari' (god) and 'anya' (other), meaning 'god of another'. In Hindu mythology, Harinya is also known as Durga and Kali, two of the most revered and feared goddesses.
